title: A Study of Air Quality Modeling Based on Transportation Sources through Bibliometric Analysis
abstract:
Abstract

Air quality models refer to mathematical representations or computer simulations of the distribution and changes in the concentration of air pollutants in specific areas or locations over time. The aim of this research is to map the current global state of research and future development trends in air quality modeling studies based on transportation sources. The results of this mapping will serve as a foundation for identifying research novelty in the topic of air pollutant dispersion models from transportation sources. This study employs a bibliometric approach by analyzing 1,122 scientific publications over half a century using the Scopus database. The findings indicate that Atmospheric Environment and the United States are the most productive publication sources and country, respectively, in the field of air quality modeling from the transportation sector. The mapping results using VOS viewer version 1.6.19 show that out of 8,590 keywords, 371 keywords were considered to meet the criteria. The clustering results show the interconnection between keywords. The more connected a keyword is, the more research has been conducted on that keyword. The mapping results indicate that several computational air quality models can be further developed for research purposes. These computational models include AERMOD, CALINE4, WRF-Chem, and CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics). These computing models have their respective advantages and disadvantages. In summary, further research is needed to develop simpler yet computationally efficient air quality models that integrate atmospheric chemical reactions and obstacle factors while maintaining high accuracy.
author: Eko Handriyono, Rachmanu;Hermana, Joni;Fadli Assomadi, Abdu;

title: An Analysis of Smart Logistics Trend using LDA Topic Modeling
abstract: This study aims to identify smart logistics trends, the trend of using cutting-edge technologies, and find actual and potential problems and issues in smart logistics focusing on examples from representative e-commerce companies in Korea, the USA, and China. To achieve this purpose, we collected 3,402 papers from Scopus, published between January 2001 and February 2024, and conducted Word Frequency, TF-IDF and LDA Topic Modeling analyses using Python 3. As a result of the study, five topics related to current trends and problems of smart logistics were identified: 'Un-tact services for customer convenience,' 'IoT-based technologies,' 'Development of Optimal Logistics Paths,' 'Technologies used in last-mile delivery,' and 'Technologies used in intelligent warehousing.' Providing smart logistics insights according on example of 3 representative e- commerce corporations of the United States, China and Korea to other companies, which can be used by them during design of implementation of new smart logistics systems or improving of existing ones is the practical contribution of this research and it proposes future research directions, specifically improving technologies used in storage and intralogistics, optimizing last-mile delivery methods and developing contactless services for consumer convenience. This study provides academic implications by filling the research gap, as previous studies on trends in smart logistics were generally not focused on a specific industry, country, or company, resulting in extensive results.
author: 페도세에바 알리나

title: Understanding global research trends in the control and prevention of infectious diseases for children: Insights from text mining and topic modeling
abstract:
Abstract

Introduction

The emergence of novel infectious diseases has amplified the urgent need for effective prevention strategies, especially ones targeting vulnerable populations such as children. Factors such as the high incidence of both emerging and existing infectious diseases, delays in vaccinations, and routine exposure in communal settings heighten children's susceptibility to infections. Despite this pressing need, a comprehensive exploration of research trends in this domain remains lacking. This study aims to address this gap by employing text mining and modeling techniques to conduct a comprehensive analysis of the existing literature, thereby identifying emerging research trends in infectious disease prevention among children.

Methods

A cross‐sectional text mining approach was adopted, focusing on journal articles published between January 1, 2003, and August 31, 2022. These articles, related to infectious disease prevention in children, were sourced from databases such as PubMed, CINAHL, MEDLINE (Ovid), Scopus, and Korean RISS. The data underwent preprocessing using the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) in Python, with a semantic network analysis and topic modeling conducted using R software.

Results

The final dataset comprised 509 journal articles extracted from multiple databases. The study began with a word frequency analysis to pinpoint relevant themes, subsequently visualized through a word cloud. Dominant terms encompassed “vaccination,” “adolescent,” “infant,” “parent,” “family,” “school,” “country,” “household,” “community,” “HIV,” “HPV,” “COVID‐19,” “influenza,” and “diarrhea.” The semantic analysis identified “age” as a key term across infection, control, and intervention discussions. Notably, the relationship between “hand” and “handwashing” was prominent, especially in educational contexts linked with “school” and “absence.” Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling further delineated seven topics related to infectious disease prevention for children, encompassing (1) educational programs, (2) vaccination efforts, (3) family‐level responses, (4) care for immunocompromised individuals, (5) country‐specific responses, (6) school‐based strategies, and (7) persistent threats from established infectious diseases.

Conclusion

The study emphasizes the indispensable role of personalized interventions tailored for various child demographics, highlighting the pivotal contributions of both parental guidance and school participation.

Clinical Relevance

The study provides insights into the complex public health challenges associated with preventing and managing infectious diseases in children. The insights derived could inform the formulation of evidence‐based public health policies, steering practical interventions and fostering interdisciplinary synergy for holistic prevention strategies.

title: COVID-19 범유행 속 소셜 미디어를 통한 여론 및 우울감 표출 텍스트의 분석
abstract: 장기화된 COVID-19의 범유행은 전 세계적인 경제 규모의 축소는 물론 사회적 거리두기와 격리, 감염과 사망에 대한 두려움, 직접적인 감염 경험 등에 의한 고립감과 소외감, 정서적인 불안정, 심리적 외상 등의 다양한 문제 또한 촉발시켰다. 이에 따라 다양한 COVID-19 관련 문제 분석 연구가 등장했으나 의학적∙경제적 측면에서 접근한 연구가 대부분이었고, 일반 대중의 정서적 상황과 관심 주제에 대해 집중적으로 탐구한 연구는 부족한 실정이다. 유사한 연구들은 대부분 특정 국가 및 지역의 데이터만을 사용하였기에 분석 결과를 일반적으로 적용하기에는 지역적 한계가 존재하였고 그밖에는 단일한 분석 기법만을 적용하였기 때문에 단면적인 분석에 국한되는 경우가 많았다. 이에 본 연구는 다국적 이용자가 이용하는 소셜 미디어인 레딧(Reddit) 내의 COVID-19 관련 주제 게시판의 텍스트를 분석하여 전반적인 대중의 텍스트적 특성을 알아보고, 나아가 우울감을 표출하는 대중들의 텍스트적 특성 또한 밝히고자 하였다.&#xD; 본 연구는 ‘COVID 19’를 검색어로 사용하여 연관성(relevance) 기준 상위 14개의 COVID-19 관련 게시판(Subreddit)에서 2020년 1월부터 2021년 2월의 기간 중 가장 많은 추천을 받은 게시글과 댓글 내의 텍스트 데이터를 수집했으며, 추가적으로 부족한 2020년 1월의 데이터를 보충하기 위해 ‘COVID19’ 혹은 ‘Corona virus’ 라는 표현이 문장에 포함된 게시글을 수집하여 분석에 사용하였다. 이후 COVID-19와 관련하여 소셜 미디어를 통해 대중들의 텍스트적 특성을 알아보기 위해 DMR 토픽모델링, 이모지 빈도분석과 월별 감성분석을 실시하였다. 또한 그 중에서 우울감을 표출하는 문장을 추출하여 해당 데이터를 대상으로 LDA 토픽모델링, 이모지 빈도분석, 월별 감성분석과 개체명 인식 분석을 수행하였다.&#xD; 연구 결과로 우선, COVID-19 범유행과 관련한 대중들의 주요 관심 주제를 발견할 수 있었다. 대중들은 ‘마스크 착용’, ‘COVID-19 증상’, ‘봉쇄령’, ‘공동체’, ‘발생 현황 보도’의 5개 주제에 대해 관심을 가지고 있었으며, 이러한 관심 주제의 부상은 해당 시기의 사회적 이슈 및 COVID-19의 유행 정도와 유의미한 연관성을 가지고 있었다. 또한 COVID-19 범유행과 대중의 감성 사이의 연결 관계를 살펴본 결과, 범유행 초기의 대중의 평균 유인가는 빠른 COVID-19 유행의 영향으로 부정적인 정서가 만연하였으나 범유행이 장기화됨에 따라 대중의 유인가는 점차 긍정적인 정서의 범주로 완화되었고 이를 통해 COVID-19 범유행과 대중의 감성의 연결 관계가 비교적 느슨해진 것을 알 수 있었다. 마지막으로 COVID-19 범유행과 관련하여 우울감을 표출하는 대중들의 텍스트를 분석한 결과, 이들은 ‘일상적 불안’과 ‘COVID-19 증상’의 주제에 주된 관심을 보였으며 범유행의 초기에 가장 낮은 유인가를 기록하며 강한 부정적 감성을 나타냈다. 이후에도 다소 완화되었으나 여전히 큰 기복 없이 부정적 감성의 범주에 속하는 평균 유인가를 보였다. 또한 개체명 인식 분석을 통해 증상, 치료, 질병, 약물의 개체명 종류의 순서로 자주 언급함을 알 수 있었고, 개체명 기반 네트워크 분석으로 치료법, 신체적 증상 그리고 감정적 증상과 관련된 세 개의 하위 네트워크와 ‘불안’, ‘증상’, ‘슬픔’, ‘비사교적’, ‘의사’ 등의 구체적인 노드들이 네트워크에서 중심적 역할을 수행함을 확인했다. &#xD; 본 연구는 대규모의 데이터를 수집하여 범유행 시작 이후 1년 동안의 시간의 흐름에 따라 데이터를 분석하였기에 더 크고 다양한 표본을 통해 장기적인 텍스트 특성의 경향과 흐름을 관찰할 수 있었다. 또한 COVID-19의 범유행과 관련하여 보편적으로 적용 가능한 해석을 도출하였고 다양한 텍스트 마이닝 기법은 물론 딥러닝 기반의 개체명 인식 분석과 같은 다양한 접근 방식을 통해 다각도로 텍스트의 특성에 대해 분석했다는 점에 있어서 의의를 가진다.
author: 박혜린

title: Nussbaum의 역량 접근법에 근거한 국내외 교육 공적개발원조 연구 동향 비교 분석
abstract: 본 연구는 교육 공적개발원조(Official Development Assistance; ODA)와 관련한 국내외 연구 문헌을 대상으로 토픽모델링을 실행하여 국내외 연구를 비교 분석함으로써 교육ODA 연구 동향을 파악하고, 향후 교육ODA 관련 연구를 위한 시사점을 제공하기 위하여 실시되었다.&#xD; 국내외 교육ODA의 연구동향을 파악하기 위해 우리나라가 OECD/DAC 회원국에 가입한 2009년부터 2020년까지 발행된 학술 논문의 영문 초록을 수집하였으며, 국내 208편, 국외 213편의 논문이 분석에 활용되었다. 수집된 영문 초록을 바탕으로 상위 빈도 키워드와 상위 TF-IDF(Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency; 역문서빈도) 단어를 추출하였으며, Python3.9의 gensim 패키지를 활용하여 국내외 각각 15개의 토픽을 도출하고, Nussbaum의 역량이론에 근거하여 분류 한 후, 전체 연구 기간을 3개의 구간으로 나누어 토픽들에 대한 추세분석을 시행하였다. &#xD; 논의된 연구결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 국내 상위 빈도 단어는 training(147회), policy(117회), government(98회), country(92회), assistance(80회)로 나타났으며, 국외 상위 빈도의 단어는 policy(88회), university(86회), training(80회), assistance(70회), school(64회)로 나타났다. TF-IDF의 경우 국내는 training(10.84615), policy(9.807129), country(8.044422), government(7.654336), school(6.128423) 순서로 관련 연구에서 중요하게 사용되고 있었으며, 국외에서는 policy(8.759756), unive rsity(7.463235), training(6.611495), China(6.568474), school(5.917034)이 차례로 중요하게 활용되었다.&#xD; 둘째, 토픽모델링의 LDA 알고리즘 수행 결과 국내에서는 교사교육, 직업교육, 기술교육, 인권, 교육정책, 고등교육 등과 관련한 15개의 토픽이 도출되었다. 국외의 경우 교육 체제, 교육 환경, 교육재정, 능력 개발, 학습자, 원격교육, 의학 교육 등과 관련한 15개의 토픽이 정해졌다. &#xD; 셋째, 도출된 토픽을 바탕으로 전체 2009년부터 2020년의 기간을 4년씩 3구간으로 나누어 추세분석을 시행한 결과, 국내에서는 2009년부터 2010년대 초반까지 주로 정책과 국제 사례를 중심으로 연구되어 오다 구체적인 프로그램 적용과 관련된 연구들이 점차 실시되었다. 국외의 경우 3구간으로 시간이 흐르며 점차 연구 문헌 수가 증가했고 이는 교육ODA에 대한 국제적 관심이 높아지고 있다는 것을 나타낸다.&#xD; 본 연구결과에 따른 연구의 한계와 후속 연구를 위한 제언은 다음과 같다. 첫째, 본 연구에서는 토픽모델링을 위하여 교육ODA와 관련한 학술지 연구 논문만이 선정되었다. 그러나 국내외 교육ODA와 관련한 연구의 경우 다양한 국제기구와 교육기관에서 관련 연구를 활발하게 수행하였다. 따라서 연구보고서를 분석 대상으로 포함한다면 보다 많은 수의 데이터로 명확한 토픽 구분이 가능할 것이다. 둘째, 토픽모델링을 수행하기 위해 우리나라가 OECD/DAC 회원국에 가입한 2009년부터 2020년까지의 논문을 수집하였다. 그러나 국외의 경우 2009년 이전부터 활발하게 ODA 분야에 관한 연구가 진행되었을 가능성이 크기 때문에 문헌 수집의 범위를 더 넓혀 분석해볼 필요가 있다. 셋째, 향후 연구에서는 MDGs, SDGs와 같은 국제적으로 주요한 사건이 이루어진 시기를 중심으로 심층적인 연구 분석을 시행한다면 더 의미 있는 결과를 얻을 수 있을 것이다. 넷째, 본 연구에서는 LDA 알고리즘만이 연구 동향을 파악하는 데 활용되었는데, LDA는 토픽의 위계적인 성격을 나타내주지 않는다는 한계가 있다. 따라서 후속연구에서 도출된 키워드 간의 관계를 설명하는 네트워크 분석을 추가로 분석한다면 주제와 핵심어 간의 연결 관계를 더욱 면밀하게 확인할 수 있을 것이다.

title: Cognitive-Inspired Deep Learning Models for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis: A Retrospective Overview and Bibliometric Analysis
abstract:
Abstract

As cognitive-inspired computation approaches, deep neural networks or deep learning (DL) models have played important roles in allowing machines to reach human-like performances in various complex cognitive tasks such as cognitive computation and sentiment analysis. This paper offers a thorough examination of the rapidly developing topic of DL-assisted aspect-based sentiment analysis (DL-ABSA), focusing on its increasing importance and implications for practice and research advancement. Leveraging bibliometric indicators, social network analysis, and topic modeling techniques, the study investigates four research questions: publication and citation trends, scientific collaborations, major themes and topics, and prospective research directions. The analysis reveals significant growth in DL-ABSA research output and impact, with notable contributions from diverse publication sources, institutions, and countries/regions. Collaborative networks between countries/regions, particularly between the USA and China, underscore global engagement in DL-ABSA research. Major themes such as syntax and structure analysis, neural networks for sequence modeling, and specific aspects and modalities in sentiment analysis emerge from the analysis, guiding future research endeavors. The study identifies prospective avenues for practitioners, emphasizing the strategic importance of syntax analysis, neural network methodologies, and domain-specific applications. Overall, this study contributes to the understanding of DL-ABSA research dynamics, providing a roadmap for practitioners and researchers to navigate the evolving landscape and drive innovations in DL-ABSA methodologies and applications.
author: Chen, Xieling;Xie, Haoran;Qin, S. Joe;Chai, Yaping;Tao, Xiaohui;Wang, Fu Lee;

title: Spatial Models of Solar and Terrestrial Radiation Budgets and Machine Learning: A Review
abstract: Currently, spatial modeling is of particular relevance as it enables the understanding of the patterns and spatial variability of an event, the monitoring and prediction of the spatial behavior of a variable, the optimization of resources, and the evaluation of the impacts of a phenomenon of interest. Research carried out recently on variables related to solar energy budgets has been of special relevance due to its applications and developments in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL). These algorithms are crucial to improve the efficiency, precision, and applicability of remote sensing, allowing greater decision making with more reliable and timely data. Thus, this work proposes a systematic and rigorous methodology for searching research articles about the latest advances and contributions related to the modeling of radiative energy budgets using novel techniques and algorithms in some of the most relevant international scientific databases (Scopus, ScienceDirect, ResearchGate). Search parameters were applied using tracking methods through various filters, specific classifiers, and Boolean operators. The results allowed for an analysis of search trends and citations in the last 5 years related to the topic of interest and the number of most relevant articles for this research, analyzed through specialized metrics and graphs. Additionally, this methodology was classified into four categories of importance for refined and articulated searches in this evaluation: (i) according to the applied interpolation methods, (ii) according to the remote sensors used, (iii) according to the applications in different fields of knowledge. As a relevant fact and with an essentially prospective purpose, a subchapter of this review was dedicated to the latest advances and developments applied to (iv) spatial modeling of terrestrial radiation through ML, this method being a tool that opens multiple alternatives for data processing and analysis in the development and achievement of objectives in the field of geotechnologies. A quantitative comparison was conducted on the predictive performance results between the classification/regression algorithms found in the studies explored in this review. The evaluation confirmed the existence of a persistent shortage of studies in recent years within the geotechnologies field, particularly concerning the comparison of spatial distribution modeling techniques developed and implemented through ML for incident solar and terrestrial radiation. Therefore, this work provides a synthesis and analysis of the most used and novel techniques in the modeling of solar energy budgets, their limitations, and biggest challenges.
author: García Pedreros, Julián Guillermo;Lagüela López, Susana;Rodríguez Martín, Manuel;

title: A bibliometric analysis of artificial intelligence applications in macular edema: exploring research hotspots and Frontiers
abstract:
Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is used in ophthalmological disease screening and diagnostics, medical image diagnostics, and predicting late-disease progression rates. We reviewed all AI publications associated with macular edema (ME) research Between 2011 and 2022 and performed modeling, quantitative, and qualitative investigations.

Methods: On 1st February 2023, we screened the Web of Science Core Collection for AI applications related to ME, from which 297 studies were identified and analyzed (2011–2022). We collected information on: publications, institutions, country/region, keywords, journal name, references, and research hotspots. Literature clustering networks and Frontier knowledge bases were investigated using bibliometrix-BiblioShiny, VOSviewer, and CiteSpace bibliometric platforms. We used the R “bibliometrix” package to synopsize our observations, enumerate keywords, visualize collaboration networks between countries/regions, and generate a topic trends plot. VOSviewer was used to examine cooperation between institutions and identify citation relationships between journals. We used CiteSpace to identify clustering keywords over the timeline and identify keywords with the strongest citation bursts.

Results: In total, 47 countries published AI studies related to ME; the United States had the highest H-index, thus the greatest influence. China and the United States cooperated most closely between all countries. Also, 613 institutions generated publications - the Medical University of Vienna had the highest number of studies. This publication record and H-index meant the university was the most influential in the ME field. Reference clusters were also categorized into 10 headings: retinal Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) fluid detection, convolutional network models, deep learning (DL)-based single-shot predictions, retinal vascular disease, diabetic retinopathy (DR), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), automated macular pathology diagnosis, dry age-related macular degeneration (DARMD), class weight, and advanced DL architecture systems. Frontier keywords were represented by diabetic macular edema (DME) (2021–2022).

Conclusion: Our review of the AI-related ME literature was comprehensive, systematic, and objective, and identified future trends and current hotspots. With increased DL outputs, the ME research focus has gradually shifted from manual ME examinations to automatic ME detection and associated symptoms. In this review, we present a comprehensive and dynamic overview of AI in ME and identify future research areas.
author: Feng, Haiwen;Chen, Jiaqi;Zhang, Zhichang;Lou, Yan;Zhang, Shaochong;Yang, Weihua;

title: Research Trends of Artificial Intelligence in Lung Cancer: A Combined Approach of Analysis With Latent Dirichlet Allocation and HJ-Biplot Statistical Methods
abstract: Lung cancer (LC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. With recent technological advances, artificial intelligence (AI) has begun to play a crucial role in improving diagnostic and treatment methods. It is crucial to understand how AI has integrated into LC research and to identify the main areas of focus. The aim of the study was to provide an updated insight into the role of AI in LC research, analyzing evolving topics, geographical distribution, and contributions to journals. The study explores research trends in AI applied to LC through a novel approach combining latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) topic modeling with the HJ-Biplot statistical technique. A growing interest in AI applications in LC oncology was observed, reflected in a significant increase in publications, especially after 2017, coinciding with the availability of computing resources. Frontiers in Oncology leads in publishing AI-related LC research, reflecting rigorous investigation in the field. Geographically, China and the United States lead in contributions, attributed to significant investment in R&D and corporate sector involvement. LDA analysis highlights key research areas such as pulmonary nodule detection, patient prognosis prediction, and clinical decision support systems, demonstrating the impact of AI in improving LC outcomes. DL and AI emerge as prominent trends, focusing on radiomics and feature selection, promising better decision-making in LC care. The increase in AI-driven research covers various topics, including data analysis methodologies, tumor characterization, and predictive methods, indicating a concerted effort to advance LC research. HJ-Biplot visualization reveals thematic clustering, illustrating temporal and geographical associations and highlighting the influence of high-impact journals and countries with advanced research capabilities. This multivariate approach offers insights into global collaboration dynamics and specialization, emphasizing the evolving role of AI in LC research and diagnosis.
